She overhears Gohan and Bulma conversation and learned that Gohan was secretly Great Saiyaman. She offers her silence in exchange for a fly around the city and also for her to practice a scene with him. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Anat is the Supreme Kai of Universe 1 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Anilaza is the result of the fusion between several members of Team Universe 3.
Arack is the God of Destruction of Universe 5. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Awamo is the Angel of Universe 1 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Iwne. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Basil is the youngest member of the Trio De Dangers. He forms a team with his brothers Lavender and Bergamo. He was first shown fighting against Majin Buu in the Zen Exhibition Match, which was two days before the actual Tournament of Power, in which his Universe did not perform well. Basil and his brothers perform best when they fight alongside each other, executing unique moves such as the Danger Triangle.
Bergamo, also known as "Bergamo The Crusher," is a member of Trio De Dangers, a team of brother fighters from Universe 9. He is the eldest brother of the trio. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Bollarator is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3.

Botamo is a fighter selected for Champa's team on the 5v5 match he has with Beerus. He is the first to fight Goku and he loses in the first round via ring out. His skin is slick, oily and hairless, and he has an ability to displace all damage he receives somewhere else.

Cabba is a warrior who is selected to be a part of Champa's team against Beerus's in Dragon Ball Super. He is a Saiyan from Universe 6, who are much more benevolent than their Universe 7 counterparts.
Campari is the attendant and martial arts teacher of Mosco. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Caulifla is a Saiyan from Universe 6 and a member of Team Universe 6 who will participate in Zen-Oh's Tournament of Power. She is the younger sister of Renso and the leader of a group of Saiyan punks. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Caway is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.

Champa is the God of Destruction of Universe 6. His name seems to come from "champagne", continuing the alcohol name puns that the Gods of Destruction and their attendants possess. He is Beerus's brother and is thus similar in appearance, but with a plumper build and a shorter tail. He also attains a similar attire but with red instead of blue. Champa seems to be impatient and loves to participate in "food showdowns" with Beerus, where they try to impress the other with tasty food. Champa is introduced with Vados as they destroy planets across Universe 7 in search of a specific one. They meet with Goku, Vegeta, Whis and Beerus after Freeza was killed a second time on Earth; naturally, Champa challenges Beerus to a food showdown and is won over by instant ramen, Earth's "tastiest food". Champa wants Earth (so as to eat as much ramen as he wants; the Earth in his universe was laid waste to by a war waged by humanity) and challenges Beerus to a 5-on-5 battle where they will each hand pick fighters from their respective universes.
Chappil is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Cocotte is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.

Cognac is the Angel of Universe 4 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Quitela. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .
Comfrey is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Cukatail is the Angel of Universe 5 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Arack. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Cus is the Angel of Universe 10. She is also the attendant and martial arts teacher of Rumsshi. She is a child of Great Priest.

An angel that resides at Zen-Oh's Palace. The Great Priest is a short man with pale blue skin, purple eyes, and slicked back white hair. The Great Priest has a blue halo on the back of his head and wears a dark green outfit with an orange triangle on his shirt. On his belt is the kanji symbol for "Grand." The Great Priest is calm and polite, still most of his personality still remains unknown, and mysterious. He has an easygoing personality, not as stern as Zen-Oh's attendants.
Damon is a tiny warrior of Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Brianne de Chateau is a warrior from Universe 2.
Dercori is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4 who uses mystical talismans in battle.

Dr. Mashirito is an evil scientist and the rival of Senbei Norimaki. He creates many robots named Caramelmen to try and surpass Arale's power but fails in his attempts. Obotchaman was one of his Carmalman but reverted to the good side.
Dr. Rota is a warrior from Universe 6 and a member of Team Universe 6.
Dyspo is the member of Pride Troopers, and Team Universe 11.
Ea is the Supreme Kai of Universe 3 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

Frost is a fighter selected on Champa's team for the 5v5 match against Beerus. He is the Universe 6 counterpart of Freeza. He plays the image of a savior to those affected greatly in war-torn regions when in reality he is the one who starts these fights so that he can make money off the land he "saves" and look good to the public.
Future Mai is Mai from Future Trunks' timeline. She is the leader of the Resistance against Goku Black. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Fuwa is the Supreme Kai of Universe 6.
The attendant of the Supreme Kai of Universe 6.

Galbi is Planet Snak's hero. He travels to Earth to challenge Mr. Satan because he believes he beat the God of Destruction Beerus. As the ambassador of Planet Snak hands Mr. Satan the Hero's Medal, Galbi interjects and wishes to test Satan's power. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Gamisaras is an invisible warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Ganos is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Geene is the God of Destruction of Universe 12. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Geppuman is a cowardly cheapskate who repeatedly eats at restaurants and leaves without paying. He loves eating and running on the bill so much that he describes it as his life, stating that he wants to be able to continue doing it without getting caught. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

The Galactic King is the king of the Milky Way Galaxy. While there are others who claim ownership of the galaxy such as the tyrant Frieza, this king could be considered the official king of the Milky Way Galaxy as he tries to keep order and protect everyone with the Galactic Patrol working under him.

In the future, he arrives on Earth and goes on a rampage, leaving humanity on the brink of extinction. He encounters Trunks and easily defeats him. Trunks survives their encounter and, for one year and half, prepares to travel back in time using a Time Machine with Bulma in an attempt to save the future. Trunks and Bulma are eventually intercepted by Gokuu Black himself when the villain kills Bulma and destroys their hideout. Trunks narrowly escapes with enough fuel for a one-way trip back to the past while Gokuu Black pursues him. Gokuu Black appears again and attacks Mai and taunts Trunks. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Gowasu is a Supreme Kai from Universe 10 and Zamasu's master.
Gryll is a wanted criminal in the Milky Way Galaxy from Planet Saute who aimed to obtain the Superhuman Water of Planet Potaufeu. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Haru is an orphaned child in Future Trunks' timeline. Maki's brother.
Helles is the God of Destruction of Universe 2.
Hermila is a warrior from Universe 2, and a member of Team Universe 2.

Hit is a warrior of an unknown race and an esteemed hitman from Universe 6, he is over 1000 years old as well. His signature technique is the Time Skip. He was the last fighter from Champa's team in the Tournament of Destroyers. It was unlike him to join an event like the Tournament of Destroyers becuase of his secluded lifestyle. He agreed to take part in the tournament because Vados offered to give him a cube that would allow him to travel between universes. Hit is first portrayed to be an impassive and silent person who only speaks when needed. During the TOD he rarely got up from his seat in the stands and always had his eyes closed because he was only there to get the cube. During the earlier parts of the tournament Hit eliminates Frost and then Vegeta showing little remorse or empathy for either of them. His biggest fight was with Goku, who was a complete opposite to him because of Goku's playful and talkative nature. Hit started to show that he was having some fun because he started to toy with him as Goku tried to figure out how his time skip worked, but he still did not see Goku as someone worth his time. Once Goku was able to predict Hit's time skips he provided Hit with a fight that he had not experienced in a long time. Hit was pushed beyond his limits as a martial artist because of Goku. Hit showed much more emotion than he usually does during this fight, it was a turning point for his character as he started to respect Goku and also wanted to become a stronger m
Hopp is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Hyssop is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Ill is the Supreme Kai of Universe 8 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

Iwne is the God of Destruction of Universe 1. He is accompanied by his attendant and martial arts teacher Awamo. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Jilcol is a warrior from Universe 10 and a member of Team Universe 10.
Jimeze is a Yardrat from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.
Jirasen is a warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.

Jiren the Gray is a member of the Pride Troopers, a Superhero team from Universe 11 that participates in the Tournament of Power. He is described by the Troopers leader, Toppo, to be the strongest man in Universe 11. Whis goes as far as saying that Jiren is a mortal which even a God of Destruction can't defeat. Jiren's home-village was attacked by an evil-doer back when he was a kid, causing the death of his parents. Jiren was rescued by a man who later became his teacher. As Jiren grew stronger, he gained new companions. Eventually, the evil-doer returned. Jiren and his companions thought they could win, but were ultimately defeated, along with Jiren's own teacher. Jiren tried to rise again, but was abandoned by the fellow surviving students he always trusted. Jiren realized that the weak could do nothing but obey the strong, which is the reason for Jiren's obsession with power.
Barry is a young A-list actor and an extremely popular celebrity on Earth during the Majin Buu Saga. He plays Great Saiyaman in the Great Saiyaman movie.
Kahseral is a cyborg warrior and general of the Pride Troopers in Universe 11. He is also the pilot of the Pride Troopers Spaceship.

Kale is a Saiyan from Universe 6 and a member of team Universe 6. She is a member of Caulifla's gang. She is often looked down upon by the Saiyans of Universe 6, in particular Cabba, who often chews her out for being too nervous. Cabba soon instructs Kale on how to unleash her anger in order to access the Super Saiyan form. However, due to Kale's pent-up stress, she is able to utilize a "berserker" state of the form. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Katopesla is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3. He is a policeman that protects his universe.
A fusion between the characters Caulifla and Kale.
Kettol is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.
Khai is the Supreme Kai of Universe 11 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Akane's older sister, who works at the coffee shop
Koitsukai is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3.
Korn is the Angel of Universe 8 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Liquiir. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Sanka Ku is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of the Kamikaze Fireballs. In her Magical Girl form, she becomes Magical Girl Kakunsa.
Kunshi is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.
Kuru is the Supreme Kai of Universe 4. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Lavender is a member of Trio De Dangers, a team of fighters from Universe 9. He is the middle brother of the trio.
Lilibeu is a warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.
Liquiir is the God of Destruction of Universe 8. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Magetta is a warrior from the sixth universe and is part of Champa's team against Beerus.' Magetta is a member of the Metalman race from Universe 6. Magetta can raise the temperature within his vicinity which can cause the whole area around to become extremely hot. Magetta was able to easily block Vegeta's Galick Gun with his Lava Spit which becomes solidified which can be used as a weapon. Magetta's weight is also so great that not even Super Saiyan Vegeta could lift him. However, one of Magetta's weakness is his low mobilty as he cannot fly. Nevertheless Vegeta himself says it is dangerous to fight him in close quarters, suggesting that he is a great melee fighter. In the manga, Magetta showed himself even more durable, as Vegeta's punches only succeeded in hurting the Saiyan himself. He was also revealed to be over 1,000 tons, making Vegeta even in Super Saiyan form unable to lift him.
Maji Kayo is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3.
Majora is a blind warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Marcarita is the Angel of Universe 11.

Martinu is the Angel of Universe 12 is the attendant and martial arts teacher of Geene. She is also one of the Great Priest's daughters. She appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Methiop is a warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.
Mojito is the Angel of Universe 9, and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Sidra. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Monaka is a character whom the God of Destruction Beerus fought at some point in the past. He was the strongest person in the seventh universe whom Beerus had ever fought, leading Beerus to place him on his team in the tournament against Champa's team.
Monna is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Mosco is the God of Destruction of Universe 3. It appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Murichim is a warrior from Universe 10 and he and his comrades are the participants that Rumsshi selected to represent him, Gowasu and Cus in the Tournament of Power.
Murisarm is a warrior from Universe 10 and a member of Team Universe 10.
Napapa is a warrior from Universe 10 and a member of Team Universe 10.
Narirama is a modified warrior residing in Universe 3. He is a contestant in the Tournament of Power.
Nigrisshi is a modified warrior residing in Universe 3. He is a contestant in the Tournament of Power.
Nink is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Obuni is a warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.
Ogma is the Supreme Kai of Universe 5 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Oregano is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Panchia is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3.
Dr. Paparoni is a warrior from Universe 3, and a member of Team Universe 3. He controls all of the artificially intelligent machine lifeforms on Team Universe 3.
Pell is the Supreme Kai of Universe 2 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Pirina is a Namekian from Universe 6 and a member of Team Universe 6 in the Tournament of Power.

Potage is the only current inhabitant of Planet Potaufeu. He also possesses the key for the seal of Commeson, determined to protect it from the invaders believing the false "Superhuman Water" rumors. Potage has the appearance of an old man, due to being at least 100 years old. He has a large beard covering most of his face, with a bald head and gray sideburns. He wears a sort of yellow protective suit of some sort, with yellow boots and sort of light brown pants as garments, most likely as a defense against invaders. His skin is a light blue color, with a sort of brown color covering on his eyes. Potage is a very noble character. For most of his life, he has done the honorable thing and protected his planet and the universe from the threat of Commeson. Unlike other fighters, he has a rather happy personality, as he went so far as hugging Monaka, a simple deliveryman, when he saw him. Although he has many noble traits, he is shown to be somewhat egotistical as he gloated about his protection of the universe from Commeson. He is shown to be fearful when he fights an opponent or opponents that are stronger than him, as he is seen quivering when Gryll and his henchmen begin to attack. He is also very informed about the history of his planet and Commeson, due to being its sole protector. Potage is not used to seeing such powerful fighters, as he is in complete shock when Trunks and Goten make quick work of Gyrll's henchmen.
Prum is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.
Quitela is the God of Destruction of Universe 4. He is accompanied by his attendant and martial arts teacher Cognac.
Rabanra is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.
The Referee is the ring announcer for the Tournament of Destroyers.
Renso is a Saiyan from Universe 6. He is a retired captain of the Sadla Defence Forces and the mentor of Cabba. He is also the older brother of Caulifla. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Su Roas is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of the Kamikaze Fireballs. In her Magical Girl form, she becomes Magical Girl Rozie.
Roh is the Supreme Kai of Universe 9 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.
Rozel is a warrior from Universe 9, and a member of Team Universe 9.
Rubalt is a soldier warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.
Rumsshi is the God of Destruction of Universe 10. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Saonel is a Namekian from Universe 6 and a member of Team Universe 6 in the Tournament of Power.
Shantza is a warrior from Universe 4, and a member of Team Universe 4.
Shisami is part of Sorbet's elite soldiers, being on par with Tagoma on the position of Sorbet's top-men.
Shosa is a warrior from Universe 4 and a member of Team Universe 4.
Sidra is the God of Destruction of Universe 9.
The barber in Penguin Village who is the father of Taro and Peasuke. He is a skilled gunman and he resembles the American actor Clint Eastwood.

Sorbet is a secondary antagonist in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection F. He is named after "sorbet," a type of frozen dessert. Sorbet was the former staff officer of the third stellar region. Years after Frieza's death, Sorbet acted as stand-in leader of Frieza's army, Sorbet then informs Frieza that Goku's power has surpassed even that of Majin Buu. Frieza is happy that Goku defeated Majin Buu, though Frieza states that this does not matter, as he can surpass him through training.
Sorrel is a warrior from Universe 9 and a member of Team Universe 9.
Sour is The Angel of Universe 2 and the attendant and martial arts teacher of Heles. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)
Super Shen Long is the Eternal Dragon who appears when the Super Dragon Balls are gathered. He was formed when the Dragon God, Zalama, formed the Super Dragon Balls.

Tagoma is a secondary antagonist in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection F. His name is a pun on the Japanese word for "egg." Tagoma is a tall purple-grey humanoid alien. He wears a new type of Battle Armor coloured black, green, and red. He also has black armbands around his wrists and has a visor-like scouter that covers both his eyes. Tagoma and his accomplice Sorbet are both elite soldiers in the Planet Trade Organization, working under Frieza. Years after Frieza's death, the two come to Earth, collect the Dragon Balls and revive their master.

An alien cop who came to Earth to stop a dangerous invader. Jaco is an alien resembling a robot with a mainly light blue head, save for his purple scalp. He has yellow eyes, and his nose and mouth are very human. His entire body is purple as well. According to Jaco, he is the 3rd shortest out of the 38 Galactic Patrolmen, at 148 cm (4' 10¼") Jaco is an alien who has a large amount of pride in his duties. He is also somewhat blank, as he was willing to use an Extinction Bomb to wipe out humanity just because Omori criticized them. He also views anyone who cannot live up to his expectations as inferior. However, this idea may be due to his extreme loyalty to his planet, so he will agree with their views on humanity. He also hates to be called short, as he nearly killed a civilian for it and also tends to get panicked quite easily. (Source: Dragonball Wikia)
The Preecho is a warrior from Universe 3, and a member of Team Universe 3.

Tights is one of the main protagonists in Jaco the Galactic Patrolman. She is the daughter of Dr. Brief and Mrs. Brief, and Bulma's older sister. Like the rest of her family, Tights' name is an allusion to an undergarment. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)
Toppo is the leader of the hero team, Pride Troopers, guardians of peace within Universe 11.
Tupper is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.
Ugg is the Supreme Kai of Universe 12 and appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

Vados is Champa's attendant and the older sister of Whis. She is introduced with Champa as they destroy planets across Universe 7, looking for a specific one. Sometime after Goku kills Freeza, they visit Whis and she watches as Champa and Beerus have a "food showdown". Champa is won over by the tastiness of Earth's instant ramen and Vados regrettably informs him that the Earth in their universe (Universe 6) was laid barren thanks to a war waged by humanity. Champa then challenges Beerus to a 5-on-5 battle where they will handpick fighters from their respective universes. The prize will be Universe 7's Earth!
Vermoud is the God of Destruction of Universe 11.
Viara is a warrior from Universe 3 and a member of Team Universe 3.
Vikal is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.
Vuon is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.

Episodes: 73-74 Dangerous parasitic criminal. He took over the body of Barry Kahn whose mind was filled with rage towards Gohan. He used this rage to turn him into a monster and cause chaos on Earth. No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .
Zamasu is the Supreme Kai apprentice of Universe 10. Zamasu is noted to have similar ki to "Goku Black", and is in someway connected to him. (Source: Dragonball Wikia)
Zarbuto is a Tuffle from Universe 2, and a member of Team Universe 2.

The Omni-King is a very small humanoid figure. He has a rather blank expression on his face and has purple and blue stripes on his face as well. He also has no nose present. He wears a pink vest on his body and on the front has two "omni" kanjis (全) present. His head has a rather lemon like shape, with his two ears being pointed and grey.
Zirloin is a warrior from Universe 2 and a member of Team Universe 2.
Zium is a warrior from Universe 10, and a member of Team Universe 10.
Zoiray is a member of the Pride Troopers who participates in the Tournament of Power.
Zunoo is a mysterious character who knows everything in the universe.

entries.name: Gon Freecss
entries.summary: Garçon solaire parti passer l'examen de Hunter pour retrouver son père — une volonté qui plie le monde.
entries.description: Garçon solaire parti passer l'examen de Hunter pour retrouver son père — une volonté qui plie le monde.

attributes.descRaw: Age: 12 (beginning), 14-15 (current) Birthday: May 5 Height: 154 cm Weight: 49 kg Eye Color: Brown Blood type: B Occupation: Hunter Nen type: Enhancement Abilities: Gon Freecss (ゴン゠フリークス, Gon Furīkusu) is a Rookie Hunter and the son of Ging Freecss. Finding his father is Gon's motivation in becoming a Hunter. He has been the main protagonist for most of the series. Gon wants to become a Hunter because he wishes to find out the depths of an occupation that would cause a father to choose the profession over being with his own son. Gon is an athletic, rustic, and friendly boy who is searching for adventure. Also, he is not very good at math. However, having spent a lot of time in the woods as a child, he is very good with animals. Simultaneously, his flaws lie in his temper and impulsive nature. Gon sometimes fails to think things through and such actions lead to him suffering. Though possessing talent far beyond the norm for his age, anytime his abilities are challenged, he feels as if he has to prove his antagonist wrong. Background: Timeline: (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wiki)
attributes.nindo: Papa, je vais te trouver — et je verrai le monde que tu as choisi plutôt que moi.
attributes.bio: Élevé sur l'île de la Baleine, Gon découvre que son père, qu'il croyait mort, est un Hunter légendaire qui l'a abandonné pour l'aventure. Sa réponse : passer l'examen le plus mortel du monde à 12 ans, se faire des amis en or (Killua, Kurapika, Leorio) — et poursuivre l'ombre de Ging jusqu'au bout de la rage.
quotes: Je suis Gon Freecss ! Et je vais trouver mon père !
Killua, tu es mon meilleur ami. C'est pour ça que je peux tout te dire.
Ça m'est égal si c'est la fin. Pour tuer Pitou, je donnerai TOUT. (transformation)
trivia: Sa canne à pêche a battu l'examen Hunter : il a « pêché » le badge de Hisoka.
Sa transformation adulte est un vœu Nen suicidaire : toute sa puissance future, brûlée en un instant.
Togashi n'a jamais confirmé s'il retrouvera un jour son Nen.
titles: Hunter à la canne à pêche
attributes.personality: Solaire, direct, incapable de mentir — et c'est précisément ce qui le rend inquiétant : la même pureté qui charme tout le monde devient, quand on lui prend quelqu'un, une absence totale de limite.

forms.label: Gon
forms.caption: Le garçon à la canne
forms.summary: Un gamin de l'île de la Baleine qui sent la forêt et fonce d'abord, réfléchit ensuite — le Renforcement fait garçon : Jajanken, pierre-papier-ciseaux mortel.

forms.label: Transformation
forms.caption: La rage faite corps
forms.summary: Devant le corps de Kite, Gon sacrifie TOUT son avenir de Nen pour la puissance immédiate : un corps adulte, une aura qui terrifie les Fourmis royales — et un prix irréversible.

entries.name: Killua Zoldyck
entries.summary: Héritier de la famille d'assassins Zoldyck, qui fuit son destin et trouve en Gon son premier ami.
entries.description: Héritier de la famille d'assassins Zoldyck, qui fuit son destin et trouve en Gon son premier ami.

attributes.descRaw: Age: 12 (Beginning), 14-15 (Current) Birthday: July 7th (2011), June 15th (1999) Height: 158 cm Weight: 45 kg Eye Color: Blue Blood Type: A Occupation: Assassin (Formerly), Hunter Nen Type: Transmutation Equipment: Skateboard, Yo-Yos Abilities: Killua Zoldyck is the third child of Silva and Kikyo Zoldyck and the heir (former) of the Zoldyck Family. He is the deuteragonist of the series Hunter x Hunter. Killua is introduced as a character similar to Gon: cheeky, cheerful, and full of bad ideas. However, contrasting Gon's politeness, Killua can be pretty rude to others, mostly strangers and older people. He is also one of the quickest-thinking characters and often analyzes a situation with great ease and accuracy. Despite his young age, his way of thinking, knowledge, and pragmatism give him the attitude of an adult. He is initially very confident about his abilities and able to gauge other people's abilities accurately. A stark contrast to his best friend Gon, Killua is highly mature in both thinking and emotion. He can keep his anger in check and maintain rationality better than Gon even when facing a terrifying experience. Character Background: Timeline: Hunter Exam Arc: Zoldyck Family Arc: Heavens Arena Arc: Yorknew City Arc: Greed Island Arc: Chimera Ant Arc: Election Arc: (Source: Hunterpedia Wiki)
attributes.nindo: Je ne trahirai jamais Gon. C'est la seule chose que je me suis jurée.
attributes.bio: Élevé pour tuer par la plus célèbre famille d'assassins du monde, Killua fugue à 12 ans pour passer l'examen Hunter « pour s'amuser » — et y rencontre la première personne qu'il veut protéger plutôt qu'éliminer. Son arc entier tient dans ce choix : l'ami plutôt que l'arme.
attributes.personality: Génie blasé au sourire de chat, gamin accro au chocolat — et tueur au sang absolument froid quand il le décide. L'aiguille d'Illumi plantée dans son cerveau lui ordonnait de fuir les plus forts : il l'a arrachée pour rester aux côtés de Gon.
quotes: Gon est ma lumière.
Un pro trouve toujours le moyen de gagner — même contre plus fort que lui.
Kanmuru : je pense plus vite que l'éclair, parce que je SUIS l'éclair.
trivia: Il s'est électrocuté volontairement pendant des mois pour transformer la torture familiale en pouvoir (Transformation).
Ses yo-yos pèsent 50 kg chacun — personne ne s'en doute jamais.
Il libère sa petite sœur Alluka, l'arme la plus dangereuse de la famille, par pur amour fraternel.

forms.label: Killua
forms.caption: L'assassin en fugue
forms.summary: Mains-lames, pas d'assassin silencieux, yo-yos de 50 kg : le prodige Zoldyck applique l'art familial… à la protection de son premier ami.

forms.label: Godspeed — Kanmuru
forms.caption: L'éclair incarné
forms.summary: L'aura électrique automatise ses réflexes : plus besoin de penser pour esquiver ni frapper — Killua devient littéralement la foudre blanche.

entries.name: Kurapika
entries.summary: Dernier survivant du clan Kurta, aux yeux écarlates ; il traque la Brigade Fantôme, chaînes au poing.
entries.description: Dernier survivant du clan Kurta, aux yeux écarlates ; il traque la Brigade Fantôme, chaînes au poing.

attributes.descRaw: Gender: Male Age: 17 (beginning); 19 (current) Height: 171 cm Weight: 59 kg Birthday: April 4 Zodiac: Aries Hair color: blonde Eye color: blue (1999); brown (manga & 2011); scarlet (when angered) Blood type: AB Nen type: Conjuration; Specialization (when his eyes are Scarlet) Abilities: Holy Chain, Dowsing Chain, Chain Jail, Judgment Chain Kurapika is a member of the Kurta tribe who were massacred by the Phantom Troupe (The Spiders) 4 years prior the Hunter exam. The Kurta tribe was an isolated group of people whose eyes would turn scarlet when angered or excited. These scarlet eyes were known to be beautiful, being one of the seven most beautiful in the world. Because of this, the Kurta tribe was constantly pursued and eventually massacred. The eyes of the tribe members were all taken away during the massacre. Kurapika is so far the only known survivor with a heart bent on revenge. He strives to have his revenge against the Phantom Troupe as well as recover the eyes of his tribe members. Despite having a heart full of hatred, Kurapika is very kind and loyal towards his friends. He is an extremely intelligent person but at the same time reckless. Kurapika is from the materialization nen group and from determination, increased the power of his nen ability to the point that it was formidable against the Phantom Troupe. Kurapika can conjure a unique weapon — five chains that extend from each finger on his right hand. Some of the fingers were specially designed to deal vengea

entries.name: Leorio Paradinight
entries.summary: Grande gueule au grand cœur, devenu Hunter pour financer des études de médecine et soigner gratuitement.
entries.description: Grande gueule au grand cœur, devenu Hunter pour financer des études de médecine et soigner gratuitement.

attributes.descRaw: Gender: Male Age: 19 (beginning); 21 (current) Birthday: March 3 Height: 193 cm Weight: 85 kg Hair color: Brown (1999), Black (2011) Eye color: Green (1999), Brown (2011) Blood type: O Occupation: Hunter, Medical Student Nen type: Emission Prior the hunter exam, Leorio's close friend died to a curable illness. Despite being curable, Leorio was unable to save his close friend due to his lack of money and knowledge. He aims to become a doctor - one that will help those even without the money to pay for treatment. He decides to take the Hunter Exam in an attempt to earn money for tuition fees and medical treatment for others. Leorio is talented at bargaining, being able to haggle shopkeepers to no end. He may at times seem brash and rude, but in the end is very kind towards his friends.

entries.name: Hisoka Morow
entries.summary: Le magicien imprévisible qui ne vit que pour affronter des proies « mûres » — allié ou bourreau selon l'humeur.
entries.description: Le magicien imprévisible qui ne vit que pour affronter des proies « mûres » — allié ou bourreau selon l'humeur.

attributes.descRaw: Birthday: June 6 Horoscope: Gemini Age: 28 Height: 187 cm Weight: 91 kg Hair color: 1999 anime - blue (Hunter Exam arc), red (Heavens Arena arc); red (2011) Eye color: blue (1999), yellow (2011) Blood type: B Occupation: Hunter, Nen type: Transmutation Notorious for his cruel and deceitful fighting ability, Hisoka has proven to be deadly. His deviousness and volatility has made many opponents have difficulty anticipating his next move, and this has led to him winning many battles. Using Shu powered poker cards as his primary weapon, he throws them with ease and deadly accuracy. Also, he is very intrigued by Gon and the potential this young boy has to become an adept and powerful adversary. Hisoka, ever looking for a strong opponent, is willing to aid, or at least not defeat prematurely, someone that could develop into a future opponent. (Source: HunterHunter Wikia, Japanese Wikipedia)

entries.name: Chrollo Lucilfer
entries.summary: Le chef calme et lettré de la Brigade Fantôme, dont le Nen dérobe les capacités d'autrui dans un livre.
entries.description: Le chef calme et lettré de la Brigade Fantôme, dont le Nen dérobe les capacités d'autrui dans un livre.

attributes.descRaw: Gender: Male Age: 26 Height: 177 cm Weight: 68 kg Hair color: Black Eye color: Black (1999), Grey (2011) Blood type: AB Occupation: Leader of the Phantom Troupe Nen type: Specialization Chrollo Lucilfer is a calm, handsome young man, coming across as intelligent and charismatic. He seems to be a born leader, able to hold the Genei Ryodan together despite the volatile personalities that make up the group, and is well versed in strategies. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

entries.name: Isaac Netero
entries.summary: Président de l'Association des Hunters, moine-guerrier au sommet du Nen malgré son grand âge.
entries.description: Président de l'Association des Hunters, moine-guerrier au sommet du Nen malgré son grand âge.

attributes.descRaw: Age: 120 Eye Color: Brown Hair color: Gray (1999), White (2011) Occupation: Hunters Association Chairman Nen type: Enhancement Abilities: 100-Type Guanyin Bodhissatva, First Hand, Third Hand, Ninety-ninth Hand, Zero Hand None other than the Chairman of the Hunter Committee, and the final authority over the entirety of the Hunter Exam. He has enough administrative power to grant anyone the Hunter's license if he decides to do so, and enough combat power to playfully avoid attacks of the main heroes single-handedly when they challenge him. All examiners, even the most despotic ones, obey his orders without talking back. He was said to be the strongest Nen user in the world 50 years ago, but he comments that he is already past his prime at his current age and that his subordinates might be stronger than him now (yet his direct subordinates disagree). Netero is also revealed to be older than Zeno Zoldyck (Killua's grandfather), who is said to be 67 years of age. At one point, Zeno says that when he was still a young boy, Netero was not only already old, but he is the only person alive who has fought with Maha (Zeno's) grandfather. Various stated times would put Netero over the three digit mark. He is able to use attacks faster than the speed of sound. His ability is known as 'Hyakushiki Kannon', or the '100-type Guanyin Bodhisattva'. This utilizes Nen to make the attacks seem as if they had come from another side and/or dimension, simply because they move so fast.

entries.name: Meruem
entries.summary: Le Roi des Fourmis-Chimères, né arme absolue — qu'une humble joueuse de gungi rendra presque humain.
entries.description: Le Roi des Fourmis-Chimères, né arme absolue — qu'une humble joueuse de gungi rendra presque humain.

attributes.descRaw: The chimera ant King, Meruem is the most powerful offspring of the chimera ant Queen. (Source: Wikipedia)

entries.name: Ging Freecss
entries.summary: Le père de Gon, archéologue de génie classé parmi les cinq meilleurs Nen du monde — introuvable par choix.
entries.description: Le père de Gon, archéologue de génie classé parmi les cinq meilleurs Nen du monde — introuvable par choix.

attributes.descRaw: Ging Freecss is Gon's father and a legendary hunter that has made many contributions to the world. He is considered one of the five strongest nen users in the world. He created the game "GREED Island" with the help of his comrades. With this, his son Gon has given a hint to find him in the game and finish it. His fighting skills and abilities are still a mystery. He knows a lot about the secret of the world beyond this world called the Dark Continent. Ging possess great leadership skills and the ability to manipulate the situation to his own use.

entries.name: Neferpitou
entries.summary: Le chat de la Garde royale, d'une loyauté absolue au Roi — son En couvre des kilomètres et son Nen ranime les morts.
entries.description: Le chat de la Garde royale, d'une loyauté absolue au Roi — son En couvre des kilomètres et son Nen ranime les morts.

attributes.descRaw: Gender: Unknown Eye Color: Red Hair Color: White Occupation: Chimera Ant Royal Guard Nen Type: Specialization Abilities: Neferpitou (ネフェルピトー, Neferupitō), nicknamed Pitou (ピトー, Pitō), is a cat-humanoid Chimera Ant and the firstborn of the Chimera Ant King's three Royal Guards. Neferpitou is very loyal to the King and will sacrifice themself for him. Of the three Royal Guards, Pitou is the most curious and would get distracted easily, and loves to play. Pitou is a cat Chimera Ant, and like a cat, loves to play with their opponents like a cat would with their prey. Despite their cheerful and playful manner, though, Pitou has a cruel and terrifying personality as well. Pitou also took their duty to protect the King seriously and is willing to sacrifice their chance to fight strong opponents to fulfill their duty. Character Background: Neferpitou is the first of the three Royal Guards born for the Chimera Ant King. They are personally named by the Queen, as were the other Royal Guards. Like Menthuthuyoupi, Neferpitou appeared to have no memories of their previous life if they had one. Timeline: (Source: Hunterpedia Wiki)

entries.name: Biscuit Krueger
entries.summary: La « petite fille » de 57 ans qui a formé Gon et Killua sur Greed Island — sa vraie forme soulève des montagnes.
entries.description: La « petite fille » de 57 ans qui a formé Gon et Killua sur Greed Island — sa vraie forme soulève des montagnes.

attributes.descRaw: Biscuit is a master and experienced teacher of Nen. She continues the Nen training Wing gave to Gon and Killua during the Greed Island arc. As a Treasure Hunter, Biscuit loves collecting rare jewels (and gets very excited about them; she has a habit of naming them) and getting money. Biscuit has a devious personality. She initially uses her cutesy appearance and demeanor to her advantage whether it's for information gathering, getting what she wants, or even in combat by acting innocent and helpless so most people will usually put their guards down around her. However, as a teacher of Nen, she has a stern and serious attitude towards her students. Though in the beginning she was out to trouble Gon and Killua, at the end of the Greed Island arc she acknowledges (albeit, in her head) that she's close to developing parental feelings toward the two of them. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Illumi Zoldyck
entries.summary: Le frère aîné de Killua, assassin au visage de porcelaine qui manipule les corps — et son propre frère — à l'aiguille.
entries.description: Le frère aîné de Killua, assassin au visage de porcelaine qui manipule les corps — et son propre frère — à l'aiguille.

attributes.descRaw: Gender: Male Age: 24 Height: 185 cm Weight: 68 kg Hair Color: Black Eye Color: Black Blood Type: A Occupation: Assassin, Hunter Nen Type: Manipulation Illumi is Killua's eldest brother. He is an experienced assassin, whom along with his father was responsible for Killua's training and upbringing. During the Hunter's Exam, Illumi camouflaged his appearance and took upon an alias, using special pins to change his entire facial structure to the point where he can only be recognized by his voice. An oppressive evil aura about him makes even Killua fearful and wary whenever he approaches Illumi. This may be due to a needle implanted into Killua's brain by Illumi. (Source: Hunter x Hunter wiki)

entries.name: Kite
entries.summary: Le disciple de Ging qui a mis Gon sur la voie des Hunters — son Nen tire une arme au hasard, Crazy Slots.
entries.description: Le disciple de Ging qui a mis Gon sur la voie des Hunters — son Nen tire une arme au hasard, Crazy Slots.

attributes.descRaw: Kite is the very first Hunter introduced in the story. He is a disciple of Ging Freecss, Gon's father. After saving Gon from a foxbear on Whale Island, Kite revealed to him the truth about his father. Before he took his leave, Kite left Ging's Hunter License in Gon's hands. After leaving Greed Island, Gon runs into Kite again, while he is in the middle of a zoological survey, searching for new species, in the country of Kakin. At the time, he was leading a team of young would-be Hunters, seven children named Banana Kavaro, Lin Koshi, Monta Yuras, Podungo Lapoy, Spinner Clow, and Stick Dinner. (Source: Wikipedia)

entries.name: Komugi
entries.summary: La joueuse de gungi aveugle, invaincue à vie — la seule à avoir jamais mis le Roi Meruem en échec… au jeu comme au cœur.
entries.description: La joueuse de gungi aveugle, invaincue à vie — la seule à avoir jamais mis le Roi Meruem en échec… au jeu comme au cœur.

attributes.descRaw: Komugi is a blind girl who is a genius at Gung-gi, a fictional board game of Hunter x Hunter. She is introduced during the Chimera Ant arc and frequently plays Meruem, the Chimera Ant King, in Gung-Gi games. Meruem seems to be developing some feelings towards her, despite her being a human. Komugi was born in a family of twelve in Republic of East Gorteau. Ever since she started to play Gungi as the country's representative, she made little money for her family. When she chose to become a professional player, she decided to kill herself if she ever lost. Komugi is a genius in Nen, being capable of using it, albeit unconsciously, without ever receiving any training. Her proficiency, however, is limited to Gungi.

entries.name: Wing
entries.summary: Le maître discret de la Tour Céleste qui enseigne les vrais principes du Nen à Gon et Killua.
entries.description: Le maître discret de la Tour Céleste qui enseigne les vrais principes du Nen à Gon et Killua.

attributes.descRaw: Nen type: Reinforcement Description: Wing is a Nen trainer whose main student is Zushi. He meets Gon and Killua at the Celestial Tower. Although in the beginning he refuses to train Gon and Killua, and even lies to them about Nen's purpose, he changes his mind when they reach the 200th floor, as he realizes they could die or be badly injured from nen "initiation". For the next several months he teaches them the basics of Nen, after which he announces they have passed the secret final requirement for being a Hunter. His teacher was Biscuit Kruger.

entries.name: Silva Zoldyck
entries.summary: Le père de Killua, sommet de l'art d'assassiner — l'un des rares à avoir affronté le chef de la Brigade et survécu.
entries.description: Le père de Killua, sommet de l'art d'assassiner — l'un des rares à avoir affronté le chef de la Brigade et survécu.

attributes.descRaw: Silva is Killua's father. A silent, pensive figure, Killua's interaction with him seems not to be much. He allows Killua to go along with Gon on their journey, but this is only so Killua will gain more experience when thrown out into the real world on his own. During the September third portion of the York Shin City arc, Silva and his father Zeno are both hired by the Mafia to assassinate the Genei Ryodan, but withdraw from the job when their clients are murdered by Illumi, Maha, and Karuto.

entries.name: Alluka Zoldyck
entries.summary: L'enfant Zoldyck habitée par « Quelque Chose » qui exauce tout vœu — contre des demandes de plus en plus terribles.
entries.description: L'enfant Zoldyck habitée par « Quelque Chose » qui exauce tout vœu — contre des demandes de plus en plus terribles.

attributes.descRaw: Alluka Zoldyck is the youngest child of the Zoldyck Family. Alluka is said to be a dark, uncontrollable child with the ability to grant wishes but can also cause large numbers of brutal deaths. Because of this vastly abnormal ability, Alluka has been locked up in a vault, behind four 10-digit-keypad password-protected security doors at home. Alluka is 11 years old and is referred to as a girl by Killua, but as a boy by their other family members. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

entries.name: Feitan
entries.summary: Le bourreau de la Brigade Fantôme : petit, létal, et son Pain Packer transforme sa douleur en soleil miniature.
entries.description: Le bourreau de la Brigade Fantôme : petit, létal, et son Pain Packer transforme sa douleur en soleil miniature.

attributes.descRaw: A mysterious member of the Phantom Troupe, Feitan is attired in what one would expect from a bandit - dark clothes with a skullhead scarf that covers his mouth. Feitan seldom speaks, but when he does, there's usually a word missing. Feitan's first language most likely isn't Japanese, but he has shown to be rather proficient in the Chinese language. He is one of the original members hailing from Meteor City.

entries.name: Nen
entries.summary: L'art de maîtriser son aura vitale : Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — le socle de tout combat de Hunter.
entries.description: L'art de maîtriser son aura vitale : Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — le socle de tout combat de Hunter.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.summary: Licence d'élite qui ouvre tous les droits : traquer trésors, créatures, criminels ou saveurs inconnues.
entries.description: Licence d'élite qui ouvre tous les droits : traquer trésors, créatures, criminels ou saveurs inconnues.

entries.name: Brigade Fantôme
entries.summary: Le Genei Ryodan : treize voleurs de classe A à l'araignée tatouée, originaires de Ryūsegai.
entries.description: Le Genei Ryodan : treize voleurs de classe A à l'araignée tatouée, originaires de Ryūsegai.

entries.name: Famille Zoldyck
entries.summary: La plus célèbre famille d'assassins du monde, retranchée sur le mont Kukurū.
entries.description: La plus célèbre famille d'assassins du monde, retranchée sur le mont Kukurū.

entries.name: Greed Island
entries.summary: Le jeu vidéo grandeur nature créé par des Hunters : une île réelle régie par des cartes aux pouvoirs fous.
entries.description: Le jeu vidéo grandeur nature créé par des Hunters : une île réelle régie par des cartes aux pouvoirs fous.

entries.name: Île de la Baleine
entries.summary: L'île natale de Gon, d'où il regardait partir les bateaux en rêvant de son père.
entries.description: L'île natale de Gon, d'où il regardait partir les bateaux en rêvant de son père.

entries.name: Fourmis-Chimères
entries.summary: Les insectes qui héritent des gènes de leurs proies — jusqu'à donner naissance au Roi Meruem.
entries.description: Les insectes qui héritent des gènes de leurs proies — jusqu'à donner naissance au Roi Meruem.

entries.summary: L'épreuve annuelle aux phases mortelles qui ne délivre qu'une poignée de licences par an.
entries.description: L'épreuve annuelle aux phases mortelles qui ne délivre qu'une poignée de licences par an.

entries.name: Tour Céleste
entries.summary: L'arène-gratte-ciel où l'on grimpe étage par étage à la force des poings — l'école du Nen de Gon et Killua.
entries.description: L'arène-gratte-ciel où l'on grimpe étage par étage à la force des poings — l'école du Nen de Gon et Killua.

entries.name: Gungi
entries.summary: Le jeu d'échecs de Chine orientale dont Komugi est la championne éternelle — le seul terrain où le Roi a plié.
entries.description: Le jeu d'échecs de Chine orientale dont Komugi est la championne éternelle — le seul terrain où le Roi a plié.

entries.name: Association des Hunters
entries.summary: L'organisation qui délivre les licences et régit l'élite : ses douze piliers portent des noms du zodiaque.
entries.description: L'organisation qui délivre les licences et régit l'élite : ses douze piliers portent des noms du zodiaque.

entries.summary: La montagne-forteresse des Zoldyck, gardée par la Porte du Crépuscule et un chien de sept mètres.
entries.description: La montagne-forteresse des Zoldyck, gardée par la Porte du Crépuscule et un chien de sept mètres.

entries.name: 200th Floor Receptionist
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Human Gender: Female Eye colour: Purple Hair colour: Petrol A woman who Gon and Killua met on the 200th floor

entries.name: Abe
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

entries.name: Abengane
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Abengane is one of the hunters hired by Battera to try and complete the game. His power becomes clear after he has a bomb placed on him by Bomber: He can remove Nen curses placed by other. This means that he is the Jyounen user the Genei Ryodan is looking for. He is eventually hired by Hisoka to remove Chrollo's curse.

entries.name: Agon
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Agon was examinee #281 in the 287th Hunter Examination. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

entries.name: Alligator
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Alligator (鰐) (ワニ, Wani) is a Chimera Ant squadron leader. Alligator is a fairly large, bipedal, albino alligator-type Chimera Ant with a purple mohawk. He wears a wrestling singlet with the Japanese character for "alligator" (鰐) written on it. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Amana
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Amana was a player on Greed Island. She is part of team Asta.

entries.name: Amane
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Amane is a female servant of the Zoldyck Family.

entries.name: Bushidora Ambitious
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Bushidora Ambitious was a Single-Star Blacklist Hunter. He was the Hunters Association's disciplinary committee member who advocates the revision of the "10 Rules for Hunters," as well as a member of the new Seirin Group. (Source: hunterxhunter.wikia.)

entries.name: Amori
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Amori is the oldest of the Amori Brothers and examinee #197 in the 287th Hunter Exam. He always wears a tuque and a polo neck sweater.

entries.name: Asta
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: One of the people working in an alliance to stop Gensuru's team. She made the demands that only people with more than 50 cards were allowed in, and they had to be of use. When she questions the use of Bisuke, Gon and Killua, who she believes are merely kids, Killua in turn questions her use. He makes her pay with rare cards in exchange for information about Gensuru's abilities. They attempt to beat Razor and the pirates to get Tsubo of the Coast, but they fail. Later on, Gensuru says he killed her and the others, infuriating Gon.

entries.name: Baise
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: One of the bodyguards hired to protect Neon. She is from the Manipulation group. Her hatsu, Instant Love, makes every man she kisses her slave. Her slaves enjoy being hurt by her, which she videotapes. She uses this to make men tell the truth.

entries.name: Balda
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Balda was in an expedition group in NGL along with Pokkle and Ponzu. They learn about the Chimera Ants, and plan to warn the outside world of the crisis at hand, however they are detected by Zazan's squad.

entries.name: Bara
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: One of the three Bomb Devils. He is beaten by Bisuke with a single punch after she reveals her true form to him.

entries.name: Baro
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Baro (バロ, Baro) is an armadillo-like Chimera Ant Officer in Leol's Squad. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Barry
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Hired by Battera, working in Tsezguerra's group, he joins Gon and the others in their battle against Razor for the Tsubo of the Coast. He's the first one to battle in boxing. He defeats his opponent without using Hatsu.

entries.name: Basho
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Basho is one of Neon Nostrade's new bodyguards, hired along with Kurapika. When he was first introduced he was quick to underestimate Kurapika, but after Kurapika's display of his 'Dowsing Chain', he grew respect for him. His nen ability is called "Great Haiku: The Wandering Haiku Poet," wherein Basho writes a haiku describing a condition on a piece of paper, which then comes true. -Wikipedia

entries.name: Bat
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Bat is a female Chimera Ant met by Gon after separating from Killua. Bat is a bat-like Chimera Ant with the ears and the wings of a bat, but other than that she looks entirely human. She dresses in lingerie and wears a band over her eyes. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Battera
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Battera is a multi-billionaire spending as much as is needed to buy as many copies of Greed Island as necessary. He makes the players sign a contract stating: don't complain if you get hurt or die, he gets to decide what cards you take with you, you get 50 billion jenny upon completion. It is revealed he spends so much money on this to get the Archangel's Breath card, to cure his comatose lover. She ends up dying before anyone has finished, and he buys his way out of the contract

entries.name: Beans
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Beans (Maamen in the Nippon Animation adaptation) is Netero's personal secretary and helps to organize a lot of things during Hunter Exam. Beans gives examinees their number badges prior to the Hunter Exam and gives a presentation on the uses of the Hunter License to the successful candidates of the Exam.

entries.name: Bendot
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Bendot is a convict used by Lippo in the Trick Tower to test the examinees. His sentence is of 199 years. Nothing is known about Bendot, but Killua analyzes that he's probably ex-military.

entries.name: Bihorn
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Bihorn is a very tall and muscled Chimera Ant that strongly resembles a minotaur.

entries.name: Knuckle Bine
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Knuckle Bine is an Unidentified Beast Hunter and Morel's apprentice. Despite appearing to be an aggressive man, Knuckle is very compassionate and easily moved to tears. Knuckle also gets along well with animals, having the habit of taking care of abandoned pets. Knuckle has all the benefits granted by his status as a Hunter. He has demonstrated considerable physical combat skills, being able to fight enemies much stronger than him.

entries.name: Binolt
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: A skilled Blacklist Hunter who's also on the wanted list himself, he has the ability to learn every bit of information from someone after chewing on someones hair that's been cut using his favorite scissors. He preys on Bisuke but does not back down after learning about her true form, requesting a match without Nen. Being beaten by Bisuke, he's being forced to practice with Gon and Killua.

entries.name: Bizeff
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

entries.name: Bodoro
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Examinee #191 during the Hunter exam. An expert at martial arts, Bodoro is a strict and seemingly stubborn old man with an unspoken rivalry with another martial artist participating in the Hunter Exam. However, this rivalry is tossed aside in the dire circumstances of Rippo's "bonus stage" after the Trick Tower. (This rivalry is only present during the original anime). When interviewed by Netero for the final stage of the Hunter Exam, his personal code of honor prevents him from fight Gon and Killua, who he sees as children, no matter their combat ability. His first battle in the fifth stage of the test is against Hisoka, who he can not even scratch, despite having a lifetime record of not a single man being able to withstand one hit by him. After a whisper in his ear by Hisoka, he admits defeat, and his next fight is against Leorio.

entries.name: Boki
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Boki (ボキ, Boki) is a beetle-like Chimera Ant.

entries.name: Bopobo
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: A convicted criminal working under Razor, he is known to have committed theft and murder, rape and murder and 11 more charges. He first loses a sumo match against Killua who burns his face. Intent on revenge, the second match Killua loses on purpose. When ordered to lose his third match against Killua on purpose, he finally rebels. He ends up getting killed by Razor.

entries.name: Franklin Bordeaux
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: A hulking, Frankensteinian monster is what Franklin (Furankurin) appears to be, complete with scars and sewn-up wounds that ravage his face. It does seem though, that beneath his harsh exterior lies a small, caring spot in his character, as Franklin acts as a care-giver to Shizuku, and shows concern of her well-being. He is also composed and respectful, normally breaking up arguments and fights within the organisation. He is one of the Genei Ryodan that originated from Ryūseigai. Nen Ability - Double Machine Gun: Franklin is a human machine gun, as his fingers cap off to reveal chambers where he channels his nen that shoot out as bullets. His fingers weren't required to be cut off and used as caps in order to achieve this, but Franklin did so because he felt "it would be more effective." Doing this actually did greatly enhance the force of his Nen Bullets, due to the commitment he showed in doing so. This power has been shown to wipe out a room full of people within seconds.

entries.name: Bourbon
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Examinee #103 during the Hunter Exam. He keeps hundreds of snakes with him, which will attack everyone who attacks him. He keeps on himself an antidote to the snake venom as a means of manipulating his opponent.

entries.name: Breath of Archangel
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Breath of Archangel is a card found in the Greed Island game. It is one of the game's 100 designated slot cards and so is required for a player to complete the game. This angel's breath will cure any illness a person may currently be suffering from. This card summons forth an angel whose breath can cure any injuries sustained upon a player. She only appears once and afterwards, the card is destroyed. You can trade all 40 spell cards in at Masadora for this card. If the maximum card limit has already been reached, then you will be given a Voucher instead. This voucher will then transform into a Breath of Archangel at the next available chance.

entries.name: Brovuda
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Brovuda is a lobster-based Chimera Ant and former Squadron Leader.

entries.name: Buhara
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: One of the second stage examiners during the Hunter exam, along with Menchi. Buhara is an epicurean hunter, and is a hulking figure with a large potbelly and an even larger appetite. Buhara's easy-going nature contrasts with Menchi's highly selective one.

entries.name: Canary
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Canary is a servant to the Zoldyck family. She may not realize it but she is Killua's friend, but thinks that their difference in status means that they can not be friends. Gon asked her why she had Killua's skateboard. She answered the first time that it was a gift. Later, she tells us he had dropped it. She has a flash back about the tiny skull in her staff. He tries to to give it to her but she refuses it. Then, he tosses it and it lands at her feet and he runs off.

entries.name: Captain
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

entries.name: Centipede
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Centipede is a chimera ant soldier from Yunju's division. Centipede is a humanoid Chimera Ant with numerous arms, yellow skin and mannequin-like articulations like most of the Chimera Ants. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Cheetu
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Cheetu (ヂートゥ, Jītu) is fastest of all the chimera ants. Cheetu is first introduced along with the other recurring squadron leaders early in the Chimera Ant story arc (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Cherry
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Examinee #76 during the 287th Hunter Exam. Cherry is a martial arts expert. During the 1st part of the Hunter exam he was confronted by murderous Hisoka. He realized the strength of Hisoka and ran, but it is implied that he was chased down and killed by Hisoka anyway, and his body left in Swindler's Swamp.

entries.name: Chimera Ant Queen
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Gives birth to all the Chimera Ants seen in the story, including the Chimera Ant King Meruem.

entries.name: Spinner Clow
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Spinner Clow, nicknamed "Spin (スピン)", is a young girl and an amateur beast hunter and member of the Kakin exploration team lead by Kite.

entries.name: Cluck
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: She is a Hunter and a member of the Zodiacs with the codename "Chicken".

entries.name: Cocco
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: The live announcer at the arena.

entries.name: Colt
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Colt (コルト, Koruto) is a Chimera Ant squadron leader. His name from when he was human is Kurt.

entries.name: Cookie
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Biscuit summons a masseuse she calls Cookie (クッキィちゃん, Kukkyi-chan) which uses different massaging techniques and a Nen-transmuted lotion to relieve fatigue and restore vitality to anyone it massages. It can also burn off excess fat and cure arthritis, muscle tension and locked joints. It is particularly useful for training/recovery purposes and to treat aging ailments. Although only one massage has been shown so far, according to Biscuit there are a lot more, some of which are cartilage massage, head massage, and roll massage. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

entries.name: Dalzollene
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Dalzollene is a leader of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards and Kurapika's direct superior. His weapon is a katana inscribed with runes that increase its power when infused Nen. In the anime, he manages to pierce Uvogin by 5 millimeters with the katana. He appears to enjoy music and is dedicated to his job. He also was not hesitant to sacrifice three of Neon's bodyguards when she predicted Troupe activity at the Yorknew Underground Auction. He had developed his Ten so that he could defend himself from ten bullets. He is later killed by Phinks, as the Phantom Troupe infiltrate a Nostrade compound in order to rescue a captured Uvogin. (Source: Wikipedia)

entries.name: Stick Dinner
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Stick Dinner is a man with an Afro hairstyle who comes to survey the country of Kakin with Kite. He is from the same town as Spinner. He likes saying puns and seems to be in charge of the group's rations. According to Kite, Stick Dinner and his fellow amateur Hunters in the Kakin Exploration Team have excellent potential to be pro-hunters. He is seen once again back in his hometown along with the rest of Kite's apprentices, Gon and Kite.

entries.name: Eeta
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Eeta is, like her twin sister Elena, one of the eleven who helped make Greed Island. One of the e's in "Greed" is after her first letter. She is in charge of moving people from the real world to Greed Island. She plays the tape for Gon, left behind by his father.

entries.name: Elena
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Elena is, like her twin sister Eeta, one of the eleven who helped make Greed Island. One of the e's in "Greed" is after her first letter. She is in charge of moving people from Greed Island to the real world, and is happy when Gon remembered her name.

entries.name: Eliza
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: One of Neon Nostrade's personal attendants. She is always seen wearing a kimono and following Neon.

entries.name: Flutter
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Flutter is one of two officers often accompanying Leol, and seems to have some authority over other equally ranked officers. Flutter's ability, Super Eye, allows him to see out the eyes of the Satellite Dragonflies he conjures for reconnaissance.

entries.name: Mito Freecss
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Mito Freecss is Gon's adopted mother, and cousin to Ging Freecss. In the manga Mito did not want Gon to become a Hunter because Ging only came back home once after he took the Hunter's exam. She did not want Gon to leave his family like Ging did. In the manga and in the 2011 anime, Ging is Mito's cousin. However in the original anime and novelization, Mito was made into the sister of Gon's mother, making Ging her brother-in-law. Mito was angry with Ging because he left her sister all alone at home and she had to watch her sister look sadly out of the window in hope of her husband returning. Her sister gave birth to Gon and died soon afterwards without seeing her husband ever again. Mito did not want Gon to become a Hunter who did not care about his family like his father. As such, she fights and wins for custody over Gon. However, now that Gon has left, she tries her best to support him in his journey. Mito is a kind woman that accepts Killua as one of Gon's friends despite learning that he is an assassin, and she feels that people must do everything they can to save another's life. When Gon and Killua found a wounded animal in the forest, Mito slapped Killua for suggesting to kill it and put it out of its misery, and because of this, they came up with the alternate solution of healing it with their nen.

entries.name: Frog
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Frog (カエル) was a Chimera Ant resembling an anthropomorphic Frog. He serves as an officer in Leol's squad. Frog wears a simple dark colored robe and small red rectangular glasses. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Fukurou
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Owl is one of the most valuable members of the Mafia community and a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons.

entries.name: Gehl
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

entries.name: Genthru
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Genthru is a Greed Island player. At first he works together with a big group of players, monopolizing defense spell cards so they can steal people's cards using offense spell cards.

entries.name: Gereta
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Examinee #384 during the Hunter exam. He is adept in hunting down animals, and is a frequent candidate for the Exam. His weapon is a blowpipe with darts laced with a neurological poison that immobilizes victims. He can track down his victim and lie undetected in the shadows, until opportunity strikes before he makes the deadly move.

entries.name: Gido
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: He is one of the three fighters that challenge Gon and Killua on the 200th floor of the Heavens Arena. Having reached the 200th floor without being able to use Nen, Gido was "initiated" after being attacked with a malicious aura attack and lost both of his legs. He is an Enhancer and can manipulate spinning tops as weapons.

entries.name: Botobai Gigante
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

entries.name: Ginta
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Is a Poacher Hunter and a member of the Zodiacs with the codename "Sheep" (未ひつじ, Hitsuji). He is also part of the Flora/Fauna Team, created in preparation for the voyage to the Dark Continent.

entries.name: Goreinu
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: A Greed Island player, he battles Razor along with Gon, Bisuke en Killua both times. He ends up giving Gon the cards he needs to win the game. His nen ability is the power to summon two gorillas made of nen. His white gorilla, White Goreinu, is able to change places with Goreinu. His black gorilla, Black Goreinu, is able to switch places with other people.

entries.name: Gothic Newscaster
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: The Gothic Newscaster is a newscaster that reported the incident in Pata City involving the former Squadron Leader Cheetu. (Source: Hunterpedia)

entries.name: Gotou
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Gotou is of the Zoldyck family manager. All contacts with the family members must go through him. An enigmatic and intimidating character, Killua once expressed to Gon his recurring nightmares of Gotou chasing him with a knife. He is also superb at the "where is the coin" trick. He cares for Killua as if he was his own son.

entries.name: Gozu
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Gozu was a strong and mighty warrior, capable of cutting a tree in two with only the use of his spear hunter and his almost superhuman strength. As a Bianu Warrior, Gozu held great pride in his strength and wanted to die in battle.

entries.name: Gyro
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Gyro is the founder and king of the NGL autonomous region. He suffered an abusive childhood at the hands of an alcoholic father. (Source: Hunterpedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

entries.name: Hanzo
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Hanzo is an 18-year old Jounin ninja from the Cloud Hidden Village whom has trained in the art of ninjutsu from the moment he could stand. He decided to become a Hunter in order to find the elusive Hermit's Scroll. After the first part of the exam, which is a marathon, Hanzo is easily able to converse while running--most of the others are breathless and struggling. In the second test, featuring cooking, he is the only one to know what 'sushi' is. He is the third candidate to clear the deadly traps and puzzles of the Trick Tower. When several people are stranded in Lippo's 'bonus stage', Hanzo takes the lead in getting them out. (Source: Wikipedia)

entries.name: Haruna
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Haruna is the benign single parent of Kurt and Reina who lives in a village in NGL. She is deeply saddened by the deaths of her son and daughter and grows weak and thin as a result.

entries.name: Nobunaga Hazama
entries.summary: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.
entries.description: Personnage secondaire de Hunter x Hunter.

attributes.descRaw: Like one of the ronin warriors in Edo period Japan, Nobunaga comes complete with a long Japanese sword that he uses with great finesse and skill. Nobunaga's speciality is the unparalleled use of the sword in executing enemies. Franklin has described him as the "King of Carelessness." His best friend is Ubogin, and the two bring out the best in each other during combat. Seeing some of Ubogin's personality in Gon, he expressed interest in having Gon join the Ryodan, though Gon adamantly refused. He is one of the Genei Ryodan that originated from Ryūseigai.
